lua_results.english: You briefly stare at the drinking fountain and sigh.
You take a small sip from the fountain. Refreshing.
Small shocks surge through the fountain.
Your reflection flickers strangely in the water.
You briefly stare at the sparkling fountain and sigh.
The fountain curiously crackles underneath you.
The fountain pulses with strange @any_colour_pattern@, and you decide not to drink from it.
You take a small sip from the fountain. @sparkling_message@
You smell the mouldering metallic scent of the fountain's ceaseless blood.
You make sure not to track any more blood on yourself.
You make sure not to track any blood on yourself.
Your reflection in the fountain writhes with quiet rage.
You briefly stop and wring some of the blood out of your mycelia.
You briefly stop and wash some of the blood off your face.
